label: Sfx: Heartwood's cast and root arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: Rootfast's two voices (v85 section 4), in the synth only. The arms are added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback, and the fallback line is re-emitted unchanged (last), so the 11 other relics that still fall through keep it and any other relic's arms row on the same anchor composes in either order. Through the patched play() both arms reproduce their lab candidates (worst 6e-08; the root on two noise draws), 76 other voices are unchanged (worst 2e-07), and ult/heartwood is no longer rune-crack. The root arm is Tendril's `bindweed-root` body verbatim with only g changed (0.5179 -> 0.2313), as its own id `heartwood-root` because Tendril's arm is not on this base. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the two voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 6e-08).

label: rootBlow: the root voice, once per rooted blow, after T.rooted++
